title: Flaky coder task tests: a_stuck_task_stops_from_any_device_and_says_why (+2 others)
body: Seen while fixing #10248 (5c221e67dd) on Boat: `task::owner::tests::a_stuck_task_stops_from_any_device_and_says_why` failed 3/4 full-suite runs with the change and 1/3 on a clean checkout. `a_replaced_program_still_starts_itself` and `a_routed_message_delivers_a_retained_patch_with_an_independent_check` each failed once in a 3-run batch. Find the timing/shared-state cause (parallel tests sharing HOME/task store, fixed sleeps, port/socket reuse) and make them deterministic; run the coder task suite 10× clean.
